scenario_register.discriminating_test: Permute timestamps within the identical graph. Measure prediction changes and disagreement with the old rule.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Cue exists. Neural use remains open.
scenario_register.observation: Timestamp rank solves 3,072/3,072 primary presentations.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Hide an interior bridge and move its returned row. Score both terminal outcomes when the bridge is switched.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Terminal copying and integration agree.
scenario_register.observation: Returned single event contains the terminal value in 512/512 audited cases per split.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Balance directed endpoint changes; compare old versus corrected distribution on the same weights.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Alphabet-order selector favors A.
scenario_register.observation: Development changed targets A:441, B:71.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Compare prefix bytes at the target boundary, full decision states and parent families. Plant a target-only difference and demand rejection.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Overlap assurance failed; actual overlaps unknown.
scenario_register.observation: Target-bearing frame was compared with bare held-out prompt.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Oracle passes and answer-copy/query-blind controls fail family qualification on actual rendered inputs.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: A correct runtime can measure an ambiguous task.
scenario_register.observation: Successful delivery coexisted with a perfect shortcut.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Compare tokenized prompts, signed endpoint odds, raw answers and complete pairs.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Query is lost, weak at readout, or dominated by action choice.
scenario_register.observation: F11 produced identical raw outputs on 767/768 changed-query pairs and solved zero pairs.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Test literal copy, one-hop two-key selection and equal-difficulty paired routes separately.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Failure is already visible on one hop; depth and difficulty covary.
scenario_register.observation: F11 mean primary approximately 17.19%, 2.47%, 0.78%, 0.65% at hops 1-4.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Measure raw answer mass, within-answer odds, and exact answer/EOS on identical prompts.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Abstention contributes but value discrimination also fails.
scenario_register.observation: Gold rank one within A-P only 21-24% for F11.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: A single controlled rescue on new families narrows attribution; failure qualifies only the tested recipe.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Data, optimization, decoding and architecture remain alternatives.
scenario_register.observation: Candidate recipes failed matched gates.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Keep F00 as frozen anchor; retest against shortcut-resistant family endpoint.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Static baseline best on this fixture.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Hold direct examples fixed, replace neutral rehearsal with availability examples; compare with a separate direct-dose replacement. Log opportunity costs.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Balanced coverage trades away direct acquisition exposure.
scenario_register.observation: Answerable allocation fell from 1,332 to 592 states per hop/epoch.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Hide an irrelevant edge with the same tool flag as a required missing edge. Score decision and downstream answer.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Behavior responds to action priors and/or actual relevance.
scenario_register.observation: F11 unavailable success ~97.80%, query terminal success ~96.82%, false abstain ~88.02% on answerable base.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Clone the initial corpus/order and checkpoint, then repeat versus refresh exactly matched strata.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Refresh competes with acquisition; initial draw also differs.
scenario_register.observation: F10 lost at every seed; corpus tags differed even in epoch zero.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Preserve separate historical identities; only a matched intervention can isolate original C.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Multiple training and rendering differences.
scenario_register.observation: Old C on Y1 primary 9.34%, F01 6.05%, F11 5.27%.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Reopen scale after acquisition; give both scales identical preregistered LR search budgets and common evaluation.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Same schedule, different compute or optimizer suitability.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Fixed train and unseen diagnostic families at logged milestones; report onset, loss and post-change time.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Skills may form and later disappear.
scenario_register.observation: Final behavior alone admits non-acquisition, interference or shortcut explanations.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Export raw records for train memorization, new instances and withheld grammar separately.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Familiar fit may precede or diverge from transfer.
scenario_register.observation: T0 receipt reports 127/128 on familiar families; raw T0 evaluation absent.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Block matched intervention by seed and corpus; distinguish family CIs from training-replication uncertainty.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Init, order and corpus can each matter.
scenario_register.observation: F00 primary ranged 22.46-41.89%; multiple trained seeds share a corpus draw.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Follow the failure branch and export a row/status for every registered stage.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: A negative screen still permits informative cheap comparisons.
scenario_register.observation: T1 failed; T2 skipped; T3 ran for failure diagnosis; D2/T4 unestablished.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Match exact final hashes and regenerate behavior from real parents; record missing lineage explicitly.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Original state may exist in saved Kaggle outputs.
scenario_register.observation: Evidence and summary support recorded replay; Y1 full weights were absent from those archives.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Issue six receipts with independent statuses; corrupt one case while preserving aggregate accuracy.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: These are distinct verification claims.
scenario_register.observation: 464,880 episodes replayed, 42,880 updates checked, 39,936 first-logit argmax matches.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Test all four on Avendi payloads plus scientific shortcut negative controls.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: New adapter could still weaken contracts.
scenario_register.observation: Historical Palantiri audit found four gaps; branch 641633a0 contains later repairs.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Measure the same qualified A checkpoint before/after learning B against equal-work A->A, and independently verify B.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Interference and differential acquisition both possible.
scenario_register.observation: Some original-kind scores regressed, including F10 seed 7 memory -85.55 pp.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Reuse historical public payload and row-order controls; qualify each skill in its own setting before composing it.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Narrow skills depend on distribution and task structure.
scenario_register.observation: V6 queries often succeeded while terminal answers failed; V7 blocked changed-payload 73/96; V7.17 LR mattered; H copied the last object on 768 presentations.

scenario_register.discriminating_test: Randomize feedback and update route, then test transfer to new entities and retention on previously acquired skills.
scenario_register.live_explanation_or_rival: Explicit correction, strategy storage, self-diagnosis and weight learning can yield different effects.
scenario_register.observation: Y1 provides no measured self-improvement loop.

falsifiers.description: One-hop complete 4-cell family accuracy across all 3 seeds >= 80%.
Three-hop complete 4-cell family accuracy across all 3 seeds >= 70%.

hypotheses.statement: Frozen Y1 S3 F00/F11 models discriminate 1-hop and 3-hop crossed queries/bridges without timestamp or last-row shortcuts.

falsifiers.description: Mean complete-family gain >= 10 pp and positive in every seed with >= 80% confirm one-hop all-four.

hypotheses.statement: Paired counterfactual endpoint margin loss on 4-cell one-hop families improves complete-family discrimination over matched CE.

falsifiers.description: Donor-specific outcome accuracy >= 80% conditional and >= 70% unconditional on both original and edited terminal suffixes.

hypotheses.statement: Exchanging the learned hop-1 16-way intermediate state between queries redirects suffix computation to the donor endpoint.
